note: Edge cases for the five scenarios. 'back' = what the back end does, in order; 'front' = what the user sees, in one consolidated answer. Placeholders in ‹› are filled from data at run time. 'src': sri = from Sri's scenario list, added = added by Claude, cross = applies to all scenarios.
